comments.note: A03 — Injection | src/git/git-credentials.ts:40 (injectCredentials). Token injection is performed via URL object property assignment (parsed.username = token) using the WHATWG URL API, NOT string concatenation. Special characters in tokens (e.g., '@', '/', '#') are automatically percent-encoded by the URL serialiser before the URL string is produced. This prevents URL injection attacks even with adversarially-crafted token values. This is the correct implementation pattern.

A09 / Credential Exposure (forward-looking, blocking concern for the next WP) | src/git/git-credentials.ts:40 (injectCredentials). The function returns a URL with the PAT embedded as userinfo. Once the orchestrator WP wires up injectCredentials(), any code path that logs, surfaces in API responses, or includes in Error messages a URL that transited through injectCredentials() MUST call stripEmbeddedCredentials() first. stripEmbeddedCredentials() is already implemented and exported. The follow-on orchestrator WP must apply it to: (1) GitResult.stderr before logging or surfacing error strings, (2) any URL field in JSON API responses, (3) the Error message in runGitOrThrow() (src/git/git-cli.ts:141). Failure to do so will expose PATs in error logs and API responses. This must be verified in the orchestrator WP security audit.

A04 — Design observation | src/git/git-credentials.ts:40 (injectCredentials). If the input URL already contains embedded credentials and no matching entry exists in the credentials map, injectCredentials() returns the original URL unchanged (including the pre-existing credentials). This is correct by design, but callers should be aware that URLs may arrive with pre-embedded credentials from external input. The isAllowedUrl() guard in git-clone.ts validates the scheme but does not strip pre-existing credentials before clone. For the orchestrator WP, confirm that user-supplied repo URLs are checked for pre-embedded credentials (hasEmbeddedCredentials) and either accepted with warning or stripped then re-injected from config.
